description: This file declares the Pause class, which implements the IPlayerTask interface for pausing a Web Audio player within the Rialto media server component. It includes references to the Web Audio player interfaces and defines the constructor, destructor, and execute method for the pause task.

classes.name: Pause
classes.description: A class representing a task to pause the Web Audio player, implementing the IPlayerTask interface.

methods.name: Pause
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the pause task with references to the player and client.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the pause operation on the Web Audio player.
